description: The specification of a DDF groupby-aggregate (ARC-12): the numeric key column to group by, and the set of aggregates (count/sum/min/max/mean) to compute over each group's columns.

column.description: The frame column aggregated; required for sum/min/max/mean, ignored for count.

op.description: The aggregate to compute over each group.

output.description: The result column's name; defaults to "<op>_<column>" (or "count") when omitted.

key.description: The frame column whose distinct values define the groups.

title: GroupBySpec
